scripture.verse: "Bless the Lord, you His angels, who excel in strength, who do His word: heeding the voice of His word."

quote.verse: "Angels worship God with purity and love, men with fear and trembling."
quote.author: James Ellis

scripture.verse: "Let their (enemies of David) way be dark and slippery, and let the angel of the Lord pursue them."

quote.verse: "Whether or not each believer has a single angel assigned to him for his defense, I dare not positively affirm."
quote.author: John Calvin

scripture.verse: (Apostles were put in prison.) "But at night an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors and let them out."

quote.verse: "The Bible clearly teaches that angels are real, and they constantly work in unseen ways on behalf of God's children."
quote.author: Billy Graham

scripture.verse: (In the throne room of the Lord) "Above it stood Seraphim, each one having six wings. With two he covered his face, with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew."

quote.verse: "Funny thing, every time an angel appears to someone in the Bible, the first thing he would say was: 'Fear not' ...I guess they (angels) were pretty spectacular."

scripture.verse: "And an angel of the Lord appeared to the woman (saying) 'You shall conceive and bear a son.' So the woman bore a son and called him Samson."

scripture.verse: "God says: 'Let all the angels worship Him' (Christ at His birth) (God) makes His angels spirits and His ministers a flame of fire."

quote.verse: "The (angels) guide, comfort, and provide for the people of God in the midst of suffering and persecution."
quote.author: Billy Graham

scripture.verse: "Then He will also say to those on the left hand, 'Depart from Me, you are cursed into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels.'"

quote.verse: "The Bible says that throughout history angels have worked to carry out God's judgments, the destinies of nations disobedient to God."
quote.author: Unknown

scripture.verse: "The Lord will say to those on the left hand, 'Depart from Me you cursed, into the everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels'...and they will go away into everlasting punishment, but the righteous into eternal life."

quote.verse: "The desire of excessive power caused the angels to fall: the desire of knowledge caused men to fall (Garden of Eden)."
quote.author: Francis Bacon

devotional.title: January 2024 - Angels as Spiritual Servents

scripture.verse: "The Angel of the Lord who has redeemed me from all evil, Bless the Lord."

body: As we begin the new year, may I open the Celestial door and with you observe God's heavenly messengers? These messengers are the angels that praise God night and day. Angels are the topic for this month and are mentioned in Genesis guarding the Tree of Life through Revelation at the final judgment Psalm 103:20-22. Let's open the Bible and see what we can learn about God"s angels.

Angels are created beings who are masculine gender according to names given in various verses (see Jude 9 & Matthew 12:26). The Archangel, Michael, Gabriel, Satan (or Beelzebub) and Cherubim are a fragment of the Host of angels God created. Angels dwell in heaven and are summoned by God to be messengers and servants. They are capable of traveling between God's throne and earth. They are not babies nor women from what we read in the Bible. We read descriptions of angels in Revelation 4:4 and Ezekiel 1:5-14.

I used three resources. Primary was the Bible. In addition, The Bible Knowledge Commentary written by James F. Walvood and Roy B. Zuck. Both men were Professors at Dallas Seminary. My third source was Nave's Topical Bible written by Orville J. Nave L.L.D.,L.D. Pastor Nave spent14 years of untiring study before writing his Topical Bible. Here are eight additional verses about angels.
1. THE TRINITY AND ANGEL OF GOD: Read Genesis 2:1 and Revelation 22:8-9. We are warned not to worship angels. They are servants of God.
4. ANGELS ANNOUNCE THREE BIRTHS: Samson, Judges 13:3, John The Baptist, Matthew 1:20, and JESUS, Luke 1:30.
6. ARE WISE, HOLY, MIGHTY, INNUMERABLE: Deuteronomy 32:36
7. SECOND COMING OF CHRIST: Luke 16:22, Revelation 4:8.
8. ANGELS AT JUDGMENT: Matthew 25:31, Mark 8:38, Jude 14 & Jude 15.
As we exit the gates of heaven together we can still hear the Angels saying, Holy, Holy, Holy, LORD GOD ALMIGHTY. How shall we respond? 1 Peter 1:13-16. Amen
